# Requirements for the DIAS MT/seismic joint-imaging pipeline
# (Sabancaya / Tacna). Generated by inspecting actual top-level imports
# across every script in this directory -- not copied from a template.
#
# Versions are intentionally UNPINNED: they have not been verified
# against the actual DIAS cluster environment. Before deploying, run
# `pip freeze` there against a working environment and pin explicitly;
# flagging this rather than guessing at numbers no one has tested.

# --- Core (required by every pipeline script, via tomomt.py and/or
#     their own top-level imports) --------------------------------------
numpy
scipy
matplotlib
xarray
pandas
pyproj

# xarray's NetCDF read/write (xr.open_dataset / tomomt.safe_to_netcdf,
# used throughout precompute.py/interpolate.py/cluster.py/plot_*.py)
# needs a NetCDF backend engine. netCDF4 is xarray's default engine;
# h5netcdf is an equally valid alternative if preferred.
netCDF4

# --- Optional, feature-gated -------------------------------------------
# Only needed if interpolate.py's INTERP_METHOD = "kriging" is selected
# (pykrige.ok3d.OrdinaryKriging3D, imported lazily inside that one
# function -- not required for RBF/IDW/nearest-neighbour interpolation).
pykrige

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOT required by the consolidated pipeline scripts (cluster.py,
# crossplots.py, interpolate.py, plot_joint.py, precompute.py,
# structure.py, plot_femtic_mesh.py, plot_modem_mesh.py,
# plot_modem_image.py, plot_seis.py): all now import only tomomt.py as
# their local module, per the 2026-08 femtic.py/modem.py consolidation.
#
# femtic.py and modem.py themselves remain in this directory as
# standalone tools (e.g. femtic.py's NPZ<->VTK/NetCDF conversion, the
# resistivity-block read->NPZ->modify->write workflow, ensemble
# generation; modem.py's Jacobian I/O, UBC/RLM conversion, wavelet
# denoising). If you run either of THEM directly rather than through
# tomomt.py, they pull in additional dependencies not otherwise needed:
#
#   femtic.py  -- requires ensembles.py (not distributed in this
#                 directory) importable on sys.path, plus:
#   joblib
#
#   modem.py   -- requires, for functions outside the read_mod/read_data/
#                 get_topo subset already consolidated into tomomt.py:
#   numba
#   PyWavelets      # imported as `pywt`
#
#   util.py    -- only its latlon_to_utm_zn()/utm_to_latlon_zn() are used
#                 (copied into tomomt.py's estimate_utm_origin() section);
#                 util.py's own workspace/HDF5 helpers additionally need:
#   h5py
